tests: Compiled exact published newReview helper with Go 1.25.0 and nats.go 1.42.0.
Executed against disposable NATS Server 2.11.4 on loopback with temporary file storage: sequence-based and stored-timestamp-based consumers both selected stream sequence 2.
Captured last sequence 3 remained the recorded ceiling after publishing sequence 4.
Missing and conflicting start-boundary arguments were rejected.
Original production-named fixture consumer delivered and acknowledgment sequence state remained unchanged.
Owned server stopped and temporary storage cleaned.
Shell snippet passed syntax check; six-edge Mermaid structure checked without graphical rendering.
Generated 1280x720 social image visually reviewed; readable title without clipping.
limitations: No production replay, export service, concurrent retention deletion or cluster failover was tested.
The helper captures an upper boundary but does not implement the complete bounded reader; reader stopping and deadline handling are explained explicitly.
Replay fixture used a quiet Limits-retention stream; WorkQueue and Interest caveats were documentation-reviewed.
No business side effects or authorization/TLS configuration was exercised.
